description: Use when an agent must price or time a Base transaction. Input: none. Output: JSON current and next base fee, priority fee tiers (slow/standard/fast from the last 20 blocks), suggested maxFeePerGas, block fullness, and typical cost of an ETH transfer, ERC-20 transfer/approve, DEX swap, NFT mint and contract deploy (L2 fee + L1 data fee) in ETH and USD. Example: /v1/onchain/base/gas Price: $0.002 USDC via x402.
name: base_gas
title: Base gas and fee estimate: base fee, priority tiers, cost per action in ETH and USD
